question: How to fix hard-to-edit condensed distribution — two different fixes, no implementation

fix_a.title: Canonical multi-file package + automated condense as build step
fix_a.summary: Keep multi-file tree as the only place humans edit. Treat megacompact_condensed_spine.py / engine.py as generated artifacts from build_condense.py (like the existing build_monolith.py pattern). CI runs condense + adversarial + import smoke; never hand-edit the giants.
fix_a.engineer_alignment: preserves gates; improves provenance of distribution form

fix_b.title: Editable spine package (megacompact_spine/) + optional one-file export
fix_b.summary: Reorganize pure-stdlib modules into a small installable package megacompact_spine/ with normal files (engineers, knowledge, smt, …). Humans edit the package. A thin export script can still emit one file for air-gapped drop, but day-to-day work is modular. Engine stays megacompact16 + pipeline as today (or a second package).
fix_b.distribution: pip-installable package primary; one-file export optional
risks: two mental models if export still used for edits

rejected.text: Make the 6k-line condensed file the primary edit target
rejected.why: recreates maintainability failure; giant diffs; collision risk

rejected.text: Simplify by removing double-pass to make files smaller

stationary_principle: Distribution forms may be generated; humans should edit modular, double-pass-gated source. Do not implement either fix in this step.
